sn34.50:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ: cattārome bhikkhave, jhāyī. katame cattāro: idha bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī
sn34.50:1.2: samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī
sn34.50:1.3: samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī
sn34.50:1.4: neva samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī
sn34.50:1.5: samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca.
sn34.50:1.8: 13. 1. 42. ārammaṇa abhinīhāra suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: cattārome bhikkhave, jhāyī. katame cattāro …pe… samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo …pe… pavaro cāti. 13. 1. 43. ārammaṇa sakkaccakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī …pe…. 13. 1. 44. ārammaṇa sātaccakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī …pe…. 13. 1. 45. ārammaṇa sappāyakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī …pe…. 13. 1. 46. gocara abhinīhāra suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo …pe… samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo …pe… neva samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo …pe… samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca …pe… pavaro cāti. 13. 1. 47. gocara sakkaccakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī …pe… 13. 1. 48. gocara sātaccakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī …pe… 13. 1. 49. gocara sappāyakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti, samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī …pe… 13. 1. 50. abhinīhāra sakkaccakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī …pe… 13. 1. 51. abhinīhāra sātaccakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: cattārome bhikkhave, jhāyī katame cattāro: idha bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī …pe… pavaro cāti.
